measurementContract: requestSeconds includes eligible dispatch, IPC, transport callbacks and durable completion; processing includes local preflight, deferral publication and authorization work excluding the measured limiter sleep; waiting is reported separately; httpSeconds is the worker exchange latency
manifestProof: synthetic-test-only; not an existing capacity qualification
candidateEnvelopeSource: earlier costs used only as a starting hypothesis; V7 requires new measured evidence
admissionMode: 3 matches under measurement; temporal admission is calculated separately from measured envelope validity
rollingWindowDefinition: requestedAt in (t-window,t], all samples including initialization; sub-hour run does not prove a saturated full hour
